inputs.text: Single continuous five-second anime shot, locked-off camera. The same girl from the input image stays waist-up in the right third, torso three-quarter, face toward the camera. At first her shoulders and upper body make a small settling motion as if she has just stopped, without a visible walking cycle. She then looks surprised: slightly widened eyes, raised eyebrows, lips gently parted. After the surprised reaction a moderate gust blows from behind her, lifting her long hair forward relative to her body and slightly sideways, keeping her face visible. Maintain facial identity, hairstyle, plain black sweater, white shirt, red tie, composition, and the stationary low-rise Tokyo house facades across the street. Restrained natural motion, no cuts, no camera movement, no additional people, no outfit changes, no speech.
